meta.title: Direction measured in capability, not calendar.
meta.description: The NEXUS roadmap is a dependency-aware sequence of engineering capabilities. Levels can overlap, but every expansion must be supported by working systems, explicit decisions and evidence that the previous layer is dependable.

position.title: Build the substrate before the frontier.
position.description: NEXUS is consolidating software foundations while turning backend and data engineering practice into repeatable systems. NGDP currently leads that progression as the primary evidence-producing build.

gates.title: A level advances when its evidence survives inspection.

items.title: Working artifact
items.description: The capability exists in a system that can be run, inspected and explained.

items.title: Repeatable operation
items.description: The result can be reproduced without relying on undocumented knowledge.

items.title: Transferable learning
items.description: The decisions and limits are documented well enough to improve the next system.

map.title: Each layer earns the next one.
map.description: The sequence protects the long-term ambition of NEXUS from weak foundations. Progress means expanding what can be designed, delivered and operated with confidence.

levels.title: Foundations
levels.description: Programming fluency, computer science fundamentals and disciplined engineering workflow form the base of every NEXUS system.
levels.evidence: Consistent implementation quality and explainable technical decisions across the repository.
levels.unlocks: Reliable software construction and stronger architectural judgement.

levels.title: Production Systems
levels.description: Backend architecture, APIs, databases and verification practices turn code into dependable software systems.
levels.evidence: A service with clear boundaries, reliable data access, documented behavior and automated verification.
levels.unlocks: Deployable services, integrations and operational ownership.

levels.title: Data Platforms
levels.description: Traceable ingestion, transformation, storage and quality practices evolve isolated datasets into useful data products.
levels.evidence: NGDP and HEVY provide repeatable, testable flows from source data to useful analytical outputs.
levels.unlocks: Trustworthy analytics and the data substrate required by intelligent systems.

levels.title: Cloud & Infrastructure
levels.description: Deployment, containers, security and observability create environments where systems can operate beyond a local machine.
levels.evidence: A reproducible deployment with health signals, controlled configuration and documented recovery paths.
levels.unlocks: Scalable delivery, operational feedback and secure system integration.

levels.title: Intelligent Systems
levels.description: Applied AI becomes a measured system capability supported by dependable software, quality data and observable infrastructure.
levels.evidence: An intelligent feature with explicit evaluation, known limits and measurable value inside a working system.
levels.unlocks: Adaptive products and more advanced forms of engineering automation.

levels.title: Advanced Research
levels.description: Integrated systems create the foundation for investigating autonomous capabilities and questions at the edge of the stack.
levels.evidence: Research artifacts that are reproducible, bounded by evidence and connected to practical system questions.
levels.unlocks: New directions determined by evidence rather than speculation.

principle.title: The sequence can adapt. The standard cannot.
principle.description: Technologies, projects and opportunities will change. NEXUS can reorder experiments when reality provides a better path, but it does not bypass the engineering evidence required to make progress credible.
rules: No capability without a working artifact
No roadmap claim without visible evidence
